[URL Rewrite]
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/.+\.googleapis.com\/.+ad_break/i then reject_img(200)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/.+\.googleapis.com\/.+log_event/i then reject_img(200)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/.+\.googleapis.com\/adsmeasurement/i then reject_img(200)
